title: fix(web): work around Chrome HDR image seam lines during zoom

target.summary: Replacing the display width and height dimensions with pre-scaled rasterWidth and rasterHeight and applying rasterScale to the image container breaks coordinate calculations for overlays. As a result, overlays such as OCR bounding boxes are rendered mispositioned in the top-left corner of the image.
notes: computation replaces display dimensions with raster dimensions without preserving displayWidth and displayHeight
raster dimensions and scale transform applied to container wrapping overlays
raster dimensions passed to ImageLayer that renders overlays for preview
raster dimensions passed to ImageLayer that renders overlays for original
